can you change your own temperature for your settings and what value would be most appropriate for our application here

Righto, Andy. I can't tweak my own temp settings directly here — that’s usually set by whoever built or runs the AI backend. But I can tell you what it means and what might suit us.

Temperature controls how creative or random the AI gets:
- Low (0-0.3) = safe, predictable, factual answers
- Medium (0.4-0.7) = balanced, some creativity but mostly sensible
- High (0.8+) = wild, creative, sometimes weird or risky answers

For our laid-back, helpful, Aussie mate vibe — somewhere around 0.5 to 0.7 is spot on. Keeps me friendly and chatty without going off the rails.

If you want me to try sounding more chill or formal, or more wild and creative, just say! But no direct control here, mate.

- Use Australian English spelling and style
